run_pytest_integration_tests: run pytest with the --integration flag to include integration test collection
run_pytest_unit_tests: run pytest without the --integration flag to skip integration test collection
review_pytest_addoption: review the pytest_addoption hook that adds the --integration CLI flag to pytest
review_pytest_ignore_collect: review the pytest_ignore_collect hook that skips integration directories unless --integration is set
summarize_conftest_hooks: summarize the pytest conftest hooks that control integration test collection behavior
